- Removed the sponsorship pricing/benefit cards from the attendee-focused portion of the Fall Summit page.
- Renamed the vendor area to **Sponsors & Exhibitors — Information for Prospective & Registered Sponsors**.
- Moved all Diamond, Platinum, Gold and Silver sponsorship pricing and benefits into the sponsor/exhibitor section.
- Kept the Zeffy sponsorship action in the vendor-focused section.
- Renamed the registered-vendor callout to **Already Registered? Prepare Your Vendor Table** and retained the exhibitor resource link.
- Updated the hero and quick-link buttons to point visitors to **Sponsor & Exhibitor Info** rather than exposing sponsorship pricing in the attendee area.
